body.x: Uptempo Global (CEO Jonghun Jack Oh) announced that it will participate in CES 2025, which will be held from January 7th (Tuesday) to January 10th (Friday) in Las Vegas, USA, under the "K-Startup Pavilion."

Founded in 2015, Uptempo Global began as a company specializing in multilingual translation and localization services. Over the years, it has built expertise in various languages and recently integrated it with digital transformation (DX) and artificial intelligence (AI) technologies to offer solutions that simplify global businesses’ operational and production processes.

With its headquarters in Korea and a branch in Vietnam, Uptempo Global employs more than 100 in-house and offsite experts. It collaborates with over 20,000 freelancers and numerous partner companies to deliver localization production and business process outsourcing (BPO) services. Through augmented operational technologies, the company is actively working to realize its vision of "digital transformation for localization processes that benefit everyone.”

Uptempo Global plans to present its Language-Tech solution at CES. This DX and AX solution supports multilingual content creation and real-time communication. It can be customized for specific domains and languages, and learning domain-specific glossaries enhances its practicality.

The company is also building an ecosystem of small language models (sLM) tailored to specialized domains based on the Korea University Human-Inspired AI Research Center’s Korean-focused large language model (KULLM). This enables the delivery of expert-level AI language solutions optimized for global business environments.

Language-Tech goes beyond simple translation by automating processes before and after translation, embodying a “localization vending machine” concept. It addresses challenges related to uniqueness, expertise, cost, and speed. Unlike general-purpose LLMs such as GPT and DeepL, Language-Tech manages detailed localization processes tailored to client needs.

In addition, Uptempo Global has developed unique technologies, including multimodal AI for integrating image and text analysis, OCR, and automatic insertion of translated text tailored for webtoons, chatbots, and QA systems that continuously learn based on user data. These innovations have enabled the company to enhance its services steadily.

A representative from Uptempo Global stated, “Language-Tech is a global business optimization solution that maximizes the practicality and sophistication of technology tailored to various languages and industry characteristics. It offers high utility across diverse fields such as content and commerce. As a result, we have secured numerous clients in the U.S., UK, Canada, Australia, Japan, Hong Kong, Thailand, and the UAE.”

The representative added, “Currently, we are collaborating with leading Vietnamese IT companies to develop multi-purpose, multilingual AI chatbot solutions and automated translation and proofreading solutions. We are also establishing an Asia headquarters in Singapore to strategically promote our brand and expand our influence in Southeast Asia. CES will be an opportunity to promote our services and explore pathways into the U.S. market. We aim to recruit companies for local collaboration in sales, technology development, etc.”

AVING News, which has covered CES for 19 consecutive years, continues to bridge the gap for Korean SMEs and startups looking to expand globally. To promote Korean startups worldwide, AVING will host its Broadcasting Zone at the Venetian Expo, featuring the CES Media Day Startup Conference and global media interviews. AVING’s international media partners will cover these programs.
Following CES 2025, AVING will co-host review conferences with participating companies in Korea, offering a platform for increased visibility and improved corporate image.
